style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, deadpan satire, bright white daylight
subject: ONE colugo, flying lemur, big round eyes, mottled grey fur, wide skin membrane between his limbs; same animal
second_characters: grasshoppers in neckties, tax clerks, huge at the lens

props.coins: blank coins, no markings, under the membrane
props.strip: a blank paper strip, unrolled at the lens

environment: jungle trunk at noon, a dense wall of leaves and vines behind him, bark chips and pollen flying
lighting: flat white daylight through the canopy, cyan edge left, warm amber fill right, no shade
motion_rule: the hero climbs and swings round the trunk on his own claws and never stops: he throws his body the full frame width ALWAYS SIDEWAYS, filling half the frame height, muzzle to the lens. The world flies INTO the lens: leaves, bark chips and clerks rush at the glass every beat. New shot size every beat, medium to close. ONE move per beat, not a chain.

audio.rate: 3.3 syllables per second, each line fits its beat
audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, speech ends by 5.60, then the leaves
audio.lip_sync: jaw opens on every syllable, mouth empty while speaking, coins held under the membrane
audio.pronunciation: tvo-I, DEN-gi, na-LOG, u-CHYOL, nay-DYOT, DZHUN-glyakh

timeline.a: drops off the branch and swings the full frame width round the trunk upside down, coins bursting from his membrane
catches the bark on the far side and hauls himself back across the frame; a clerk snatches a coin at the glass
rakes the coins back under the membrane on the move and swings the full width back; two clerks tumble over the lens
hauls himself up the bark hand over hand, membrane flapping edge to edge; a clerk unrolls a paper strip at the lens
whips the full frame width across the bark the other way, muzzle to the lens; clerks sweep sideways over the glass
throws himself the full width back, bark chips bursting; a clerk drags the paper strip right across the lens
hurls his body the full frame width, coins trapped under the snapping membrane; three clerks shoot across the lens
drives along the trunk through the leaves, membrane tight to his belly, muzzle to the lens; clerks stream past both sides
he hurls himself the full frame width into the deep green leaf wall and is gone, grey fur flashing against the green
the clerks rip the leaves apart right across the lens and there he is, leaves bursting at the glass
he shakes so hard the whole leaf wall shakes with him, clerks swinging on it; his grey muzzle fills the frame, eyes on them
leaves rain off him across the lens as the clerks swarm over the branch
he claws sideways along the shaking branch, bare paws up, clerks streaming past
bark chips and leaves sweep across the lens

must_appear: at 0.00 mid swing across the frame, coins bursting from the membrane; he vanishes into the leaf wall at 5.60; the clerks tear the leaves open and find him at 6.20; at 6.70 the leaf wall shaking with him, his muzzle filling the frame, eyes on the clerks
